relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 was characterized as a receptor for capsaicin

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX binds irreversibly to wildtype (Y) TRPV1 subunits but can be washed off Y511A (A) mutant subunits

key_findings: Capsaicin association constant is about 2.4e6 per M for wildtype TRPV1 subunits and about 100-fold lower for Y511A
Capsaicin binding steps are independent with no detectable cooperativity; Y511 acts like a turnstile securing vanilloid binding
